title: An Effective $S$-Matrix Approach to Low-Frequency Waveforms from Black Hole Mergers
summary: We develop an on-shell description of low-frequency gravitational waveforms from black-hole mergers beyond leading order. Treating the strongly coupled merger as effective hard $S$-matrix data, we organize its long-wavelength response using soft theorems and the KMOC formalism. At next-to-leading order, the quantum soft theorem contains logarithmic terms absent from the classical soft theorem.
